resources.string: THE GREEN SHOP uses your location to pinpoint your delivery address and provide real-time live map tracking of your order.
Watch your delivery rider on the map with accurate minute-by-minute ETAs.
Guarantees your farm-fresh groceries arrive quickly at the exact location.
Location is used only while fulfilling orders and is never shared or sold.
Location access was previously disabled. Please allow location in Android Settings to unlock live GPS delivery tracking.
Your device location/GPS is switched off. Please turn on location services for accurate live delivery tracking.
You have granted Approximate Location. For real-time turn-by-turn map tracking, Precise Location is recommended.
